title: AJMS ProfileReference v0.1
description: Minimal exchange convention: tells a recipient which profile exists, in which version and where it can be retrieved. Carries no profile content. Access control is the responsibility of the hosting or transport solution. Community Draft - not an adopted standard.

profileUrl.description: Where the profile document can be retrieved (https). Retrieval may require authorization by the host.

accessMethod.description: PUBLIC: no authorization. ACCESS_CONTROLLED: the host authorizes each request. ON_REQUEST: ask via accessRequestUrl first.

contentDigest.description: Optional integrity hint over the referenced document (SHA-256 of its canonical JSON serialization, see docs/privacy-and-exchange.md). Not a signature: it does not prove who created the document.

intendedRecipient.description: Free-text label of the recipient a SHARED_VIEW is meant for. Not an access control mechanism.

allOf.$comment: A full private profile is never announced as publicly retrievable.
